title: Joyful Canadian Biscuits Bake
description: Roasted, gooey festive biscuit bake with maple glaze inspired by Canadian winter, made with whole30-friendly digestive biscuits and a nut butter crust.
instructions: Preheat your wood-fired oven or conventional oven to 175°C (350°F).
In a bowl, mash the whole30-friendly digestive biscuits into coarse crumbs using a fork or roller.
Add the unsweetened applesauce, coconut oil, maple syrup, ground cinnamon, sea salt, and nut butter to the crumbs and mix until a moist dough forms.
Fold in the sliced almonds, chopped dried cranberries, and fresh rosemary if using.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and press the dough mixture into an even layer about 1 cm thick.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the edges turn golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly before slicing into squares.
Drizzle additional maple syrup over each square for extra gooeyness.
Sprinkle extra sliced almonds on top for added crunch.
Serve warm and enjoy the rustic, maple-infused Canadian biscuit bake.
